'''Safari Receptionist''' is an [[NPC]] located in the {{zone|Critter Safari Entrance}} on the {{Zone|Torrhus Canyon}}. She introduces the player to the {{Zone|Critter Safari}}.

&e[NPC] &aSafari Receptionist&f: &fBefore you head in, there are three rules you ought to know.
&e[NPC] &aSafari Receptionist&f: &c&lRule One: &fYou can't bring any items, armor, or potions inside with you.
&e[NPC] &aSafari Receptionist&f: &fThe only exception is your &fSafari Belt&f - that, you're welcome to bring along.
&e[NPC] &aSafari Receptionist&f: &fIf you don't have one yet, go and grab one from &aAndrea&f upstairs.
&e[NPC] &aSafari Receptionist&f: &c&lRule Two: &fYou can only hunt using the &cCritter Capsules&f we provide when you enter.
&e[NPC] &aSafari Receptionist&f: &fSome &a Critters&f are trickier to catch than others, but you'll get the hang of it!
&e[NPC] &aSafari Receptionist&f: &c&lRule Three: &fThe &2Critter Safari&f takes no responsibility for any bites, scratches, or bruised egos sustained on your visit.
&e[NPC] &aSafari Receptionist&f: &f...Have fun!
